reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §1(a) engages Services 'on a task by task basis' under mutually agreed SOWs, and §3(a) fixes compensation on a time-and-materials basis plus reimbursed actual expenses, so fees are owed only for services ordered and performed — the MINCOMMIT preferred position.

No minimum, take-or-pay, shortfall, prepaid/non-refundable, or usage-cap language appears in the supplied paragraphs or definitions; the only Customer-side volume-relevant constraint noted (§6(a) convenience-termination gating) is correctly flagged as a term/exit issue outside this rule's scope.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no counterparty comment are proposed, and the rendered redline is byte-identical to the originals; deterministic checks are empty, so there is no contrary evidence.

Minor characterization nit only: p0033 is the material-breach termination clause rather than a general true-up provision, but its 'fees and expenses ... incurred or earned ... through the effective date' language does support the no-penalty conclusion, so the rationale remains accurate in substance.
